mapper.sql: ( SELECT ii.src_doc_type, ii.src_doc_id, ii.src_doc_item_id, SUM(ii.invoiced_amount) invoiced FROM invoice_item ii JOIN invoice iv ON iv.id = ii.invoice_id WHERE iv.status <> 'voided' GROUP BY ii.src_doc_type, ii.src_doc_id, ii.src_doc_item_id )
( SELECT pl.invoice_id, SUM(pl.amount) settled_amount FROM payment_line pl JOIN payment_doc pd ON pd.id = pl.payment_id WHERE pd.status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY pl.invoice_id )

choose.when: SELECT 'inbound' src_doc_type, d.id src_doc_id, i.id src_doc_item_id, d.doc_no src_doc_no, d.doc_date, i.item_id, it.item_code, it.item_name, it.spec, it.unit, i.quantity, COALESCE(i.tax_inclusive_total, 0) src_amount, COALESCE(inv.invoiced, 0) invoiced_so_far, COALESCE(i.tax_inclusive_total, 0) - COALESCE(inv.invoiced, 0) remaining FROM inbound_doc d JOIN inbound_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id JOIN purchase_order po ON po.id = d.ref_doc_id JOIN item it ON it.id = i.item_id LEFT JOIN inv ON inv.src_doc_type = 'inbound' AND inv.src_doc_id = d.id AND inv.src_doc_item_id = i.id WHERE d.ref_type = 'purchase' AND d.ref_doc_id IS NOT NULL AND po.supplier_id = #{partyId} AND COALESCE(i.tax_inclusive_total, 0) - COALESCE(inv.invoiced, 0) > 0 ORDER BY d.doc_date, d.doc_no, i.line_no
choose.otherwise: SELECT 'outbound' src_doc_type, d.id src_doc_id, i.id src_doc_item_id, d.doc_no src_doc_no, d.doc_date, i.item_id, it.item_code, it.item_name, it.spec, it.unit, i.quantity, COALESCE(i.tax_inclusive_total, 0) src_amount, COALESCE(inv.invoiced, 0) invoiced_so_far, COALESCE(i.tax_inclusive_total, 0) - COALESCE(inv.invoiced, 0) remaining FROM outbound_doc d JOIN outbound_doc_item i ON i.doc_id = d.id JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = d.ref_doc_id JOIN item it ON it.id = i.item_id LEFT JOIN inv ON inv.src_doc_type = 'outbound' AND inv.src_doc_id = d.id AND inv.src_doc_item_id = i.id WHERE d.ref_type = 'sales' AND d.ref_doc_id IS NOT NULL AND so.customer_id = #{partyId} AND COALESCE(i.tax_inclusive_total, 0) - COALESCE(inv.invoiced, 0) > 0 ORDER BY d.doc_date, d.doc_no, i.line_no

mapper.select: SELECT ii.src_doc_type, ii.src_doc_id, ii.src_doc_item_id, SUM(ii.invoiced_amount) invoiced FROM invoice_item ii JOIN invoice iv ON iv.id = ii.invoice_id WHERE iv.status <> 'voided' GROUP BY ii.src_doc_type, ii.src_doc_id, ii.src_doc_item_id

choose.when: SELECT s.id party_id, s.supplier_name party_name, COALESCE(r.received_amount, 0) received_amount, COALESCE(iv.invoiced_amount, 0) invoiced_amount, COALESCE(p.settled_amount, 0) settled_amount FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT po.supplier_id, SUM(COALESCE(iti.tax_inclusive_total, 0)) received_amount FROM inbound_doc d JOIN inbound_doc_item iti ON iti.doc_id = d.id JOIN purchase_order po ON po.id = d.ref_doc_id WHERE d.ref_type = 'purchase' GROUP BY po.supplier_id ) r ON r.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT party_id, SUM(total_amount) invoiced_amount FROM invoice WHERE invoice_type = 'purchase' AND status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY party_id ) iv ON iv.party_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pd.party_id, SUM(pl.amount) settled_amount FROM payment_line pl JOIN payment_doc pd ON pd.id = pl.payment_id WHERE pd.status = 'confirmed' AND pd.pay_type = 'payment' GROUP BY pd.party_id ) p ON p.party_id = s.id ORDER BY s.id
choose.otherwise: SELECT c.id party_id, c.customer_name party_name, COALESCE(r.received_amount, 0) received_amount, COALESCE(iv.invoiced_amount, 0) invoiced_amount, COALESCE(p.settled_amount, 0) settled_amount FROM customer c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT so.customer_id, SUM(COALESCE(oti.tax_inclusive_total, 0)) received_amount FROM outbound_doc d JOIN outbound_doc_item oti ON oti.doc_id = d.id JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = d.ref_doc_id WHERE d.ref_type = 'sales' GROUP BY so.customer_id ) r ON r.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT party_id, SUM(total_amount) invoiced_amount FROM invoice WHERE invoice_type = 'sales' AND status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY party_id ) iv ON iv.party_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pd.party_id, SUM(pl.amount) settled_amount FROM payment_line pl JOIN payment_doc pd ON pd.id = pl.payment_id WHERE pd.status = 'confirmed' AND pd.pay_type = 'receipt' GROUP BY pd.party_id ) p ON p.party_id = c.id ORDER BY c.id

mapper.select: SELECT iv.id invoice_id, iv.doc_no, iv.invoice_date, iv.total_amount, iv.sign, iv.source_type, COALESCE(p.settled_amount, 0) settled_amount FROM invoice iv LEFT JOIN p ON p.invoice_id = iv.id WHERE iv.invoice_type = #{type} AND iv.party_id = #{partyId} AND iv.status = 'confirmed' ORDER BY iv.id

choose.when: SELECT po.id order_id, po.doc_no, po.doc_date, COALESCE(po.total_tax_inclusive, 0) order_amount, COALESCE(r.received_amount, 0) received_amount, COALESCE(iv.invoiced_amount, 0) invoiced_amount, COALESCE(iv.settled_amount, 0) settled_amount FROM purchase_order po LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.ref_doc_id, SUM(COALESCE(iti.tax_inclusive_total, 0)) received_amount FROM inbound_doc d JOIN inbound_doc_item iti ON iti.doc_id = d.id WHERE d.ref_type = 'purchase' GROUP BY d.ref_doc_id ) r ON r.ref_doc_id = po.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d2.ref_doc_id, SUM(COALESCE(ii2.invoiced_amount, 0)) invoiced_amount, SUM(COALESCE(ii2.invoiced_amount, 0) * COALESCE(s2.settled_amount, 0) / NULLIF(iv2.total_amount, 0)) settled_amount FROM invoice_item ii2 JOIN invoice iv2 ON iv2.id = ii2.invoice_id AND iv2.invoice_type = 'purchase' AND iv2.status = 'confirmed' JOIN inbound_doc d2 ON d2.id = ii2.src_doc_id AND d2.ref_type = 'purchase' LEFT JOIN s2 ON s2.invoice_id = iv2.id GROUP BY d2.ref_doc_id ) iv ON iv.ref_doc_id = po.id WHERE po.supplier_id = #{partyId} ORDER BY po.id
choose.otherwise: SELECT so.id order_id, so.doc_no, so.doc_date, COALESCE(so.total_tax_inclusive, 0) order_amount, COALESCE(r.received_amount, 0) received_amount, COALESCE(iv.invoiced_amount, 0) invoiced_amount, COALESCE(iv.settled_amount, 0) settled_amount FROM sales_order so LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.ref_doc_id, SUM(COALESCE(oti.tax_inclusive_total, 0)) received_amount FROM outbound_doc d JOIN outbound_doc_item oti ON oti.doc_id = d.id WHERE d.ref_type = 'sales' GROUP BY d.ref_doc_id ) r ON r.ref_doc_id = so.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d2.ref_doc_id, SUM(COALESCE(ii2.invoiced_amount, 0)) invoiced_amount, SUM(COALESCE(ii2.invoiced_amount, 0) * COALESCE(s2.settled_amount, 0) / NULLIF(iv2.total_amount, 0)) settled_amount FROM invoice_item ii2 JOIN invoice iv2 ON iv2.id = ii2.invoice_id AND iv2.invoice_type = 'sales' AND iv2.status = 'confirmed' JOIN outbound_doc d2 ON d2.id = ii2.src_doc_id AND d2.ref_type = 'sales' LEFT JOIN s2 ON s2.invoice_id = iv2.id GROUP BY d2.ref_doc_id ) iv ON iv.ref_doc_id = so.id WHERE so.customer_id = #{partyId} ORDER BY so.id

mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM invoice WHERE invoice_type = 'purchase' AND status = 'confirmed') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pl.amount), 0) FROM payment_line pl JOIN payment_doc pd ON pd.id = pl.payment_id WHERE pd.status = 'confirmed' AND pd.pay_type = 'payment') ap_balance, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM invoice WHERE invoice_type = 'sales' AND status = 'confirmed') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pl.amount), 0) FROM payment_line pl JOIN payment_doc pd ON pd.id = pl.payment_id WHERE pd.status = 'confirmed' AND pd.pay_type = 'receipt') ar_balance
